# Collab News | Eggplant, Chili... Are We Making a Dish?
 
Great news, Adventurers!
Those hard-earned potatoes are finally ready for the kitchen!
Throw in some eggplant and chili, and voilà—a delicious dish!
Wait... where did the eggplant and chili come from?
They're none other than the limited Visages from Vegetables Fairy Collab Pt. 2!
 
>> Spicy Chick Plush Outfit Set
A fiery little Spicy Chick! Take a bite... whoa, that's hot!
 
>> Rose Dog Plush Outfit Set
Soft pink petals and a chubby little body—too cute to handle!
 
>> Violet Kitty Suit Set
An eggplant or a cat? Hmm... that is the question...
 
>> Chili, Eggplant & Rose Weapon Set
Bright red chili, giant eggplants, and elegant thorny roses!
They'd definitely make some cool weapons!
 
>> Weird and Wonderful Headwear Set
Carrot Crab! Lemon Whale! Mushroom Ferret!
They're all joining the party in Kanstein!
And there's even a huge mushroom, perfect to use as an umbrella!
 
That's all for the collab-exclusive Visage showcase!
Do you still have enough potatoes in your warehouse?
Share your potato stash in the comments below now!

# Dungeon Preview | Venture into the Crystal Spiral Tree!
 
Hey, Adventurers! Naira here!
Reach the top of Acme Nexus, and Aethyris awaits!
With Reina leading the way, we've arrived at our very first dungeon—the Crystal Spiral Tree!
 
This colossal ancient tree towers over Aethyris,
its roots reaching deep into the crystal veins beneath the kingdom.
Now, a lightning-wielding Chaosborn has made the tree its lair,
spreading corruption through its roots and into the earth below.
 
Here's the intel on the Crystal Spiral Tree!
Head inside and drive out the Chaos monsters lurking within!
 
Ah... wait! Adventurer!
Looks like you've picked up some Chaos corruption too!
Quick, go find Saintess Astrid—
she'll know what to do...!

# Aethyris PV | That Time We Crushed Chaos Just to Save Akane
 
Atop the Acme Nexus, the Adventurer and Akane are just about to set foot in Aethyris when—surprise! A Chaosborn swoops in and snatches Akane away!
"Akane's been kidnapped?! What about all the materials in my cart?!"
Well... looks like we're heading to Aethyris after all!
 
Finale of Chaos begins today!
Adventurers, set your sights on the floating city above the clouds
and put an end to the source of the Chaos invasion!

# EventOverview | Thunderous Crusade Is Now Live!
Hey, Adventurers! Naira here!
 
Thunder splits the sky as a divine figure steps through an otherworldly rift.
He commands the heavens and wields the thunder itself.
Lord of Olympus. King of the Gods. Zeus.
But what brings the supreme god himself to Kanstein?
What does he seek here, and where will his path lead?
Before the thunder rolls on, let's take a closer look at Zeus!
 
**Divine Devotions**
Sign in for 7 days for great rewards! Get the Pantheon Grace Visage free on Day 1!
Pure white robes adorned with a golden laurel sash,
worn beneath the blessing of the gods.
 
**Thunderous Adventure**
New story stages are here! Follow Zeus's journey and uncover what brought him to Kanstein and where fate will take him next.
Clear the story stages to earn 20 Wheel Tickets and get one step closer to having Zeus as your Companion!
 
**Conquest Echoes**
Piece together memories of the Thunderous Crusade to reveal stunning illustrations!
Complete the full collection to earn 27 Wheel Tickets!
 
**Apotheosis Crucible**
Ready to face Zeus's trials? Show what you're made of!
Take on the challenge each day for Daily Rewards, build Hype to unlock milestone rewards, and earn rare items like Stellaties and Auroral Badges!
 
**Thunderous Vault**
The vault of the King of the Gods is opening its doors.
What treasures lie within? Head in-game and find out!
 
There's plenty up for grabs throughout Thunderous Crusade!
Earn 62 Wheel Tickets for free, plus all three Visage pieces: Headwear, Facewear, and Outfit, along with rare items including Stellaties, Auroral Badges, and Bond Trinkets!
And there's more! The sacred Zeus Statue is coming to your Home. Equip the Statue Chroma and bask in a touch of Olympian splendor!
That's all for the event highlights. Have fun, Adventurers!

# ✨ Join the Sword × Staff Creator Partnership Program and Earn Exclusive Rewards! ✨
Dear Adventurers and Creators,
Love playing Sword × Staff and creating content along the way? Turn that passion into rewards, exclusive perks, and opportunities to be featured by the official team!
The Sword × Staff Creator Partnership Program is now live! Whether you're a streamer, guide creator, fan artist, or tool developer, we'd love to have you join us and help bring the world of Kanstein to life in new ways.

🎯 Who We're Looking For
We're looking for creators who are passionate about Sword × Staff and create original content in the following areas:
🎬 Videos & Livestreams: Gameplay, guides, commentary, fan-made videos, livestreams, and more.
🎨 Fan Art: Character and environment art, chibi illustrations, comics, and other fan creations.
📝 Visual & Written Guides: Class guides, gameplay tutorials, tips, fun facts, and other informative content.
🛠️ Tools: Wikis, event calendars, seasonal timelines, and other useful tools.
💡 Note: Your account must already have at least 1 piece of Sword × Staff content when you apply.

🎁 What Creators Get
💰 Creator Rewards: Earn rewards based on both the number of pieces you create and their performance, with incentive programs tailored to different content types and platforms.
👑 Exclusive Creator Recognition: Unlock the Official Creator role on our Discord server and get featured as a Recommended Creators in the in-game community.
🚀 Official Promotion: Outstanding content may be featured across our official channels, including social media reposts and event preview posts. Featured works will be selected based on performance, relevance, and overall quality.

📝 How to Apply
The Creator Partnership Program is open on an ongoing basis!
1. For details on creator categories, requirements, and rewards, see the [Creator Partnership Guidelines](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1E_xGRURaHzx0Bqyvc3Jfl-iFl8B9lb4Xh9Orth9GtNY/edit?tab=t.0).
2. Submit your application through the [Application Form](https://forms.gle/ZMLqxkauQdnVZcs59)
Application Review: Applications are reviewed twice a month.
Official Contact: If your application is approved, our team will contact you within 7 business days after the review to discuss long-term collaboration and the Creator Partnership Agreement. Please make sure your contact information is accurate and up to date.

Thank you to every adventurer and creator for your passion and support. We can't wait to see what you create and build an even more vibrant Sword × Staff community together!

Sword × Staff Operations Team

# Notice Regarding Recent Server Issues
Dear Adventurers,

From **October 23, 2026, 19:58 to 22:11 (UTC-5)**, a server configuration issue caused some Adventurers to be incorrectly connected to a non-official game environment. As a result, some players found that their existing characters or game progress were not displayed correctly, while others discovered that characters created and progress made during the affected period were no longer available after logging back in.

**The issue has now been resolved, and normal server access has been restored.** We are currently reviewing the affected accounts and game records and working on a compensation plan.

## I. What Should Affected Players Do?
### 1. If You Already Had a Character Before the Issue
If you logged in during the affected period and found that your character or game progress was missing, please log in again and return to your original character on the official server.

**Your existing character and progress on the official server have not been affected.** Once the compensation plan is finalized, compensation will be sent to your affected character on the official server.

### 2. If You Started Playing and Created a Character During the Affected Period
Unfortunately, since you were connected to a non-official game environment, the character you created and any progress made during that time cannot be retained.

Please log in again **using the same login account as before** and create a new character on an official server to continue your adventure.

**Make sure to use the same login account** so we can verify your previous game records. Once the compensation plan is finalized, compensation will be sent to your newly created character on the official server.

## II. How Can I Confirm I'm on an Official Server?
You can check by following these steps:
1. Go to the game's login screen.
2. Tap **Server List** in the top-right corner.
3. Check the server name. **If the server name is not made up entirely of numbers, you're connected to an official game server.**

## III. Purchases Made During the Affected Period
We will review and handle all purchases made during the affected period on a case-by-case basis to ensure that the corresponding paid items and benefits are properly accounted for.

If you have any other questions or are still experiencing issues with your character, game progress, or purchases, please contact us through the in-game Customer Support. We'll be happy to help investigate and resolve your issue.

We sincerely apologize for the confusion and inconvenience this has caused. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

**The Sword × Staff Team**
